Ambiguous addresses are now offered by suburb.

## Changed

- **`geocode_address` names the suburb each answer lies in.** The AtlasFetch API now returns `matched.suburb` on every answer and alternative: the suburb the point actually lies in, where `matched.locality` is the place the caller wrote. When it is time to ask the customer, the alternatives are told apart by something a customer recognises:
  ```
  street · confidence 0.47 · ambiguous · Long Street, Cape Town City Centre, Cape Town, ZA-WC — ask the customer before dispatching
    or: Long Street, Observatory, Cape Town (5.6 km SE of the first); Long Street, Maitland, Cape Town (6.8 km E of the first); …
  ```
  Each keeps its distance and direction from the first answer, for two candidates in one suburb. A confident answer shows its suburb too: `25 Adderley Street, City Centre, Cape Town`. Where the suburb is the place written, it appears once.

No tool, input or default changed.
